originating_goal: Determine whether the apparent rise in documentary-style UAP/UFO media from 2017-2026 is related to incremental United States government UAP disclosure/reporting/declassification activity, preserve evidence classes in separate locations, and test Bob Lazar as a longitudinal claim-lineage case.

tasks.title: Preserve research hypothesis and competing explanations
Install and validate physical evidence-class separation
Acquire and receipt official UAP event sources for 2017-2026
tasks.release_condition: The bounded source queue is processed without credentials, authoritative objects are retained under official-records with hashes/provenance, and each item is independently class-validated.

tasks.title: Build documentary/media corpus with reproducible inclusion criteria
tasks.release_condition: The media inclusion contract is installed and the initial corpus is independently sourced, dated, deduplicated, class-valid, and receipt-linked.

tasks.title: Build Bob Lazar atomic claim and evidence-reference ledger
tasks.release_condition: Sufficient testimony, archival/historical, official-record, technical/scientific, media-primary, and secondary-reporting objects exist to construct atomic claims without collapsing evidence classes.

tasks.title: Build general-documentary and platform-growth control corpus
tasks.release_condition: A reproducible non-UAP documentary/control dataset exists for the same relevant years and platforms with its own inclusion rules and source receipts.

tasks.title: Execute event-window, lag, terminology, and source-lineage analysis
tasks.release_condition: UAP-MEDIA-004, UAP-MEDIA-005, UAP-MEDIA-006, and UAP-MEDIA-007 are COMPLETE or explicitly SUPERSEDED with evidence.

tasks.title: Independent reconstruction and governed review
tasks.release_condition: A reviewer independently reconstructs the evidence-class assignments, timelines, atomic claims, controls, and derived analyses and records result-changing disagreements before any causal/publication finding.

session_consolidation.archive_condition: Every remaining UAP research task retains a durable owner and machine-observable release condition, evidence-class validation remains active, and any source-acquisition worker path is installed without non-TV/TVC credential authority.
